patch.summary: Jira Service Management cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Jira Service Management pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. 7-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.

blocks.title: Jira Service Management plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

blocks.heading: Jira Service Management cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Jira Service Management against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (premium unlock) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (incident management, change and problem management, service catalog) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Jira Software is a different product — do not buy JSM expecting full Work OS PM. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.
